mechanism: Amiodarone prolongs QT interval and increases risk of torsades de pointes; gentamicin is nephrotoxic and ototoxic, with aminoglycosides known to potentiate cardiac arrhythmias and increase amiodarone levels through renal impairment.
action: Monitor cardiac rhythm closely with ECG; assess renal function regularly; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; ensure adequate hydration and adjust gentamicin dosing for renal function.
